title: 脳情報科学
subtitle: Brain Information Science
educationalGoal: Brain is the basis of psychological functions. The rapid development of brain research method allowed the clarification of brain functions in various psychological processing. The goal of this course is to provide students with the basic knowledge of brain functions such as “attention & eye movement”, “long/short term memory”, “Emotion and its control”, “Emotion & brain waves”, “Cognitive control & decision making”, “Social cognition” and “Theory of mind”.
advice: This course proceeds with the combination of lectures, quiz and exams on important topics of brain science such as “attention & eye movement”, “long/short term memory”, “Emotion and its control”, “Emotion & brain waves”, “Cognitive control & decision making”, “Social cognition” and “Theory of mind.” Students are required to learn the contents in the integrated way. The course is consisted of four main topics on which some lectures, quiz and an exam will be provided. 1) the brain research methods (e.g., EEG, fMRI, NIRS) and the brain function of attention and eye movement (3weeks) 2) long/short term memory and working memory (3weeks) 3) information processing on emotion (4 weeks) 4) higher cognition (cognitive control, decision making, social cognition and theory of mind) (3 weeks) Because there are four exams for each topic, students are not evaluated by a final exam but are required to pay much attention to each topic. Note: This course is a part of requirements of Certified Public Psychologist.
requiredKnowledge: Students are required to understand the learning contents of “Cognitive neuroscience”, and “Psychology of information processing”.

Be able to understand the basis of psychology and brain science.
Be able to explain fundamental factors to construct a system that suits psychological processing.
